science.title: RHD shock tube (Problem 2 states) evolved with the entropy equation (ENTROPY_SWITCH=ALWAYS)
science.mechanism: The Problem 2 state pair is evolved with ENTROPY_SWITCH=ALWAYS, so the code advances the conserved entropy (Src/entropy_switch.c and the RHD entropy flux) and recovers pressure from entropy instead of total energy everywhere in the domain, with RK2 time stepping and the MC limiter.
science.distinct_from_other_rows: It is the only pure-RHD row where the energy equation is replaced by the entropy equation in the whole domain; the relativistic entropy flux, its conversion to pressure and the corresponding primitive recovery branch are exercised nowhere else.
science.failure_modes_exposed: A port that silently keeps the energy equation, mis-scales the relativistic entropy density (rho*sigma with the Lorentz factor), or uses the wrong recovery branch produces different post-shock states at t = 0.4 even if the energy-based rows pass.
references: Mignone, A. & Bodo, G. 2005, MNRAS 364, 126 (HLLC solver for relativistic flows I: hydrodynamics)
Mignone, A., Bodo, G., Massaglia, S., et al. 2007, ApJS 170, 228 (PLUTO)

policy.active_rule: abs(candidate - reference) <= 1e-12 + 1e-8 * abs(reference) for every finite value of every declared raw binary64 DBL payload and frame; byte-identical payloads take a fast path; shape/frame/artifact/finite gates are hard gates.
policy.active_rule_status: owner-approved provisional combined tolerance shared by every row of this suite (same rule as the merged pluto-mhd-les suite); not a row-calibrated scientific error bar.
policy.case_specific_policy_shape: Contact/shock positions and plateau values; difference from the energy-equation solution (which is a known, physically expected offset at shocks); conservation of mass and entropy in smooth regions.
policy.evidence_required_before_numeric_bound: Two reproducible incumbent runs; genuinely different correct binaries (compiler/ISA/FMA); a resolution or replication study of the named observables; at least one plausible porting defect that the policy rejects; and a recorded owner decision.
policy.determinism_note: One-rank incumbent reruns of this configuration are expected to be byte-identical (fixed operation count per step except for the primitive-recovery Newton iterations in Src/RHD/mappers.c, whose stopping test compares a float residual against a fixed tolerance). A faithful port that reassociates arithmetic can change a recovery iteration count at a flip point; that is a MEASURED-class hazard under references/determinism-triage.md and is why the provisional bound is not yet a calibrated one.

output_contract.format_family: PLUTO 'dbl' static-grid output convention (this row's shipped deck's [Static Grid Output] stanza selects dbl in single_file mode).
expected_markers: data.<NNNN>.dbl (per-dump snapshot; NNNN zero-padded frame index)
output_contract.frames: initial dump data.0000.dbl at t=0 plus 1 dump(s) every 0.4 time units ending at tstop=0.4 (final dump coincides with the last interval)
output_contract.byte_layout: grid.out (Src/set_grid.c) is ASCII: header comment lines, then 3 per-axis blocks each '<N>' followed by N lines '<i> <xl> <xr>' (interior points, ghosts excluded). dbl.out (Src/write_data.c) is ASCII, one line per dump: '<nfile> <time> <dt> <step> <single_file|multiple_files> <little|big> <name1> <name2> ...'. data.<NNNN>.dbl (Src/bin_io.c FileWriteData) is raw float64 with no header, native byte order, variable-major, x-fastest within each variable block, interior zones only. Variable names come from Src/var_names.c; radiation rows append enr, fr1, fr2, fr3 after the fluid block (Src/RHD/mod_defs.h, Src/HD/mod_defs.h, Src/MHD/mod_defs.h, Src/RMHD/mod_defs.h index macros). tests/checks/*/validate.py implements exactly this layout and compares every retained finite value.

criteria.name: dbl_payload_equivalence
criteria.note: Applied to every finite raw binary64 value of every declared frame; the first violation fails the row with frame/index/variable diagnostics.
